# Claude Code Prompt: Modern BOS-ARSA Homepage

## Context

Build a modern, single-page homepage for **BOS-ARSA** (Österreichischer Amateurfunkverein der Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben — BOS-Amateur-Radio-Society-Austria). This is an Austrian amateur radio club specifically for members of police, fire, rescue, and other public safety organizations (BOS = Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben).

The current website (https://bos-arsa.at/) is a basic WordPress page with minimal design. We need a **professional, modern, authoritative** replacement that conveys trust, precision, and the dual identity of emergency services + amateur radio.

## Tech Stack

- **Single HTML file** with inline CSS and minimal JS (no build tools needed)
- Use Google Fonts via CDN
- Use Lucide Icons or similar via CDN
- Responsive design (mobile-first)
- German language throughout

## Color Palette — "Police Blue" Theme

Inspired by Austrian police/BOS emergency services aesthetics. Use these as the primary palette:

```
--bos-navy:        #0A1628;    /* Deep navy — header, footer, hero background */
--bos-blue:        #003DA5;    /* Austrian police blue — primary brand color */
--bos-blue-light:  #1A5FC7;    /* Lighter interactive blue — buttons, links */
--bos-blue-bright: #2E7DE6;    /* Bright accent — hover states, highlights */
--bos-silver:      #C0C8D4;    /* Cool silver — borders, subtle text */
--bos-gold:        #C9A84C;    /* Authority gold — accents, badges, star elements */
--bos-white:       #F0F2F5;    /* Cool off-white — backgrounds */
--bos-red:         #CC2936;    /* Emergency red — alerts, important callouts */
--bos-dark:        #0D1B2A;    /* Near-black — text */
--bos-gray:        #374151;    /* Body text */
```

Additional design tokens:
- Subtle blue gradient overlays on hero section
- Dark backgrounds with light text for header/footer (authoritative feel)
- Gold accents sparingly for badges and important highlights
- Red only for emergency/CTA elements

## Design Direction

**Aesthetic: Authoritative & Technical — like a modern government agency site meets radio operations center**

- Clean, structured grid layout with sharp edges (no rounded corners > 4px)
- Subtle geometric patterns or radio wave motifs as background textures
- Strong typography hierarchy with a condensed/bold display font
- Professional photography placeholders (use gradient placeholders with radio/emergency icons)
- Subtle animations on scroll (fade-in sections)
- Dark hero section transitioning to lighter content areas

## Page Structure & Content

### 1. Navigation Bar (sticky)
- BOS-ARSA logo area (left) — use text "BOS-ARSA" with a shield/radio icon
- Nav links: Über uns | Vorstand | Ziele | Mitglied werden | Kontakt
- Compact, dark background (`--bos-navy`)

### 2. Hero Section
- Full-width dark section with subtle radio wave animation or geometric pattern overlay
- Main headline: **"Amateurfunk im Dienst der Sicherheit"**
- Subtitle: "Der österreichische Amateurfunkverein der Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben"
- Two CTA buttons: "Mitglied werden" (gold/bright) and "Mehr erfahren" (outline)
- Subtle animated radio wave or signal pulse effect

### 3. "Über uns" Section
- Brief intro paragraph about BOS-ARSA
- Text: "Der Verein bezweckt die Erhaltung, Förderung und Verbreitung des Amateurfunkwesens innerhalb des Wirkungsbereiches der Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben (BOS)."
- 3 feature cards in a row:
  - 🛡️ **Sicherheit** — "Amateurfunk als verlässliche Kommunikation für BOS-Organisationen"
  - 📡 **Vernetzung** — "Verbindung von Funkamateuren aus Polizei, Feuerwehr und Rettung"
  - 🎓 **Ausbildung** — "Förderung der Amateurfunk-Kompetenz im BOS-Bereich"

### 4. "Vorstand" Section (Board Members)
- Clean card grid layout
- Members with role, name, and a subtle rank/badge indicator:
  - **Präsident** — Gabrutsch Wolfgang, BA MBA MBA DBA
  - **Generalsekretär** — Londer Erich, BA
  - **Kassier** — Ing. René Camaur
  - **Kassier Stellvertreter** — Joham Thomas
  - **Schriftführer** — Kugi Jürgen
  - **Schriftführer Stellvertreter** — Weger Erwin
- Use gold accent on the role label, shield/star icons for president

### 5. "Ziele" (Goals) Section
- Dark background section for contrast
- Main goal text prominently displayed
- Icon list of key objectives:
  - Förderung des Amateurfunks in BOS-Organisationen
  - Ausbildung und Weiterbildung von Funkamateuren
  - Zusammenarbeit mit nationalen und internationalen Organisationen
  - Unterstützung der Notfallkommunikation

### 6. "Mitglied werden" (Join) Section
- Eye-catching section with gold/blue gradient accent
- Headline: "Werde Teil unseres Teams"
- Subtext: "Du bist in einer BOS-Organisation tätig und hast eine Amateurfunklizenz? Dann bist du bei uns richtig!"
- Requirements listed cleanly:
  - Tätigkeit in einer BOS-Organisation (Polizei, Feuerwehr, Rettung, Bundesheer, etc.)
  - Gültige Amateurfunklizenz
- CTA button: "Kontakt aufnehmen" → mailto:office@bos-arsa.at

### 7. "Partner" Section
- Small section showing support:
- "Mit freundlicher Unterstützung von:"
- safeREACH.com logo area (placeholder)
- Link to BOS-ARSA Logging Tool: bosarsalog.oeradio.at

### 8. Footer
- Dark (`--bos-navy`) footer
- Impressum data:
  - Österreichischer Amateurfunkverein der Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben – BOS-Amateur-Radio-Society-Austria (BOS-ARSA)
  - c/o Wolfgang Gabrutsch
  - Zuständige Vereinsbehörde: Landespolizeidirektion Kärnten
  - 9020 Klagenfurt am Wörthersee, Buchengasse 3
  - ZVR-Zahl: 1783847541
  - office@bos-arsa.at
- Copyright line: © 2025 BOS-ARSA. Alle Rechte vorbehalten.

## Design Details

### Typography
- Display/Headlines: **"Barlow Condensed"** (bold, condensed — military/tactical feel) or similar condensed sans-serif
- Body text: **"Source Sans 3"** (clean, professional, highly readable)
- Monospace for any technical/callsign displays: **"JetBrains Mono"**

### Key Visual Elements
- Thin gold line separators between sections
- Shield icon motif (combining radio waves + BOS authority)
- Subtle CSS radio wave animation (concentric expanding circles, low opacity) in the hero
- Card hover effects with subtle blue glow
- Section entrance animations (fade-up on scroll using IntersectionObserver)

### Responsive Behavior
- Desktop: Full grid layouts, horizontal nav
- Tablet: 2-column grids, same nav
- Mobile: Single column, hamburger menu, stacked cards

## Important Notes

- All text in **German**
- The tone should be **professional, authoritative, trustworthy** — this represents law enforcement and emergency service professionals
- Avoid anything playful or casual — this is a serious organization
- The blue color scheme should feel like Austrian police / Bundesheer official communications
- Include proper HTML meta tags (charset, viewport, description, Open Graph basics)
- Ensure accessibility: proper heading hierarchy, alt texts, sufficient contrast ratios, focus states
- The page should feel like it could represent a real government-adjacent organization, not a hobby club

## File Output

Create a single `index.html` file that is self-contained and can be deployed to any static hosting (Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, etc.).

'hidden' : '';\n    });\n\n    // Close mobile menu on link click\n    navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {\n      link.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        navLinks.classList.remove('open');\n        navToggle.classList.remove('active');\n        navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');\n        navToggle.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Menü öffnen');\n        document.body.style.overflow = '';\n      });\n    });\n\n    // Scroll reveal animation with IntersectionObserver\n    const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');\n    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach(entry => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('visible');\n          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, {\n      threshold: 0.12,\n      rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px'\n    });\n\n    revealElements.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));\n\n    // Stagger animation for cards in the same row\n    document.querySelectorAll('.features, .board-grid').forEach(grid => {\n      const cards = grid.querySelectorAll('.reveal');\n      cards.forEach((card, i) => {\n        card.style.transitionDelay = `${i * 0.1}s`;\n      });\n    });\n  </script>\n</body>\n</html>\n"

    16→  <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest"></script>
    17→  <style>
    18→    /* ===== CSS Reset & Custom Properties ===== */
    19→    *, *::before, *::after {
    20→      margin: 0;
    21→      padding: 0;
    22→      box-sizing: border-box;
    23→    }
    24→
    25→    :root {
    26→      --bos-navy:        #0A1628;
    27→      --bos-blue:        #003DA5;
    28→      --bos-blue-light:  #1A5FC7;
    29→      --bos-blue-bright: #2E7DE6;
    30→      --bos-silver:      #C0C8D4;
    31→      --bos-gold:        #C9A84C;
    32→      --bos-white:       #F0F2F5;
    33→      --bos-red:         #CC2936;
    34→      --bos-dark:        #0D1B2A;
    35→      --bos-gray:        #374151;
    36→
    37→      --font-display: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;
    38→      --font-body: 'Source Sans 3', 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif;
    39→      --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    40→
    41→      --container: 1200px;
    42→      --nav-height: 64px;
    43→    }
    44→
    45→    html {
    46→      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    47→      scroll-padding-top: var(--nav-height);
    48→    }
    49→
    50→    body {
    51→      font-family: var(--font-body);
    52→      color: var(--bos-dark);
    53→      background: var(--bos-white);
    54→      line-height: 1.6;
    55→      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    56→      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    57→    }
    58→
    59→    img {
    60→      max-width: 100%;
    61→      display: block;
    62→    }
    63→
    64→    a {
    65→      color: var(--bos-blue-light);
    66→      text-decoration: none;
    67→      transition: color 0.2s;
    68→    }
    69→
    70→    a:hover {
    71→      color: var(--bos-blue-bright);
    72→    }
    73→
    74→    a:focus-visible {
    75→      outline: 2px solid var(--bos-blue-bright);
    76→      outline-offset: 2px;
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    .container {
    80→      max-width: var(--container);
    81→      margin: 0 auto;
    82→      padding: 0 24px;
    83→    }
    84→
    85→    /* ===== Section Divider ===== */
    86→    .section-divider {
    87→      width: 60px;
    88→      height: 2px;
    89→      background: var(--bos-gold);
    90→      margin: 16px auto 0;
    91→    }
    92→
    93→    .section-divider--left {
    94→      margin-left: 0;
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    /* ===== Scroll Animations ===== */
    98→    .reveal {
    99→      opacity: 0;
   100→      transform: translateY(30px);
   101→      transition: opacity 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
   102→    }
   103→
   104→    .reveal.visible {
   105→      opacity: 1;
   106→      transform: translateY(0);
   107→    }
   108→
   109→    /* ===== Navigation ===== */
   110→    .nav {
   111→      position: fixed;
   112→      top: 0;
   113→      left: 0;
   114→      right: 0;
   115→      z-index: 1000;
   116→      background: var(--bos-navy);
   117→      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(192, 200, 212, 0.1);
   118→      height: var(--nav-height);
   119→      transition: box-shadow 0.3s;
   120→    }
   121→
   122→    .nav.scrolled {
   123→      box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
   124→    }
   125→
   126→    .nav__inner {
   127→      display: flex;
   128→      align-items: center;
   129→      justify-content: space-between;
   130→      height: 100%;
   131→    }
   132→
   133→    .nav__brand {
   134→      display: flex;
   135→      align-items: center;
   136→      gap: 10px;
   137→      color: #fff;
   138→      font-family: var(--font-display);
   139→      font-weight: 800;
   140→      font-size: 1.4rem;
   141→      letter-spacing: 1px;

   143→      text-decoration: none;
   144→    }

   154→      display: flex;
   155→      align-items: center;
   156→      justify-content: center;
   157→      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bos-blue), var(--bos-blue-light));
   158→      border: 1px solid var(--bos-gold);
   159→      border-radius: 3px;
   160→    }
   161→
   162→    .nav__brand-icon i {
   163→      color: var(--bos-gold);
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    .nav__links {
   167→      display: flex;
   168→      align-items: center;
   169→      gap: 8px;
   170→      list-style: none;
   171→    }
   172→
   173→    .nav__links a {
   174→      display: block;
   175→      padding: 8px 14px;
   176→      color: var(--bos-silver);
   177→      font-family: var(--font-body);
   178→      font-size: 0.9rem;
   179→      font-weight: 500;
   180→      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
   181→      transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
   182→      border-radius: 3px;
   183→      text-decoration: none;
   184→    }
   185→
   186→    .nav__links a:hover,
   187→    .nav__links a:focus-visible {
   188→      color: #fff;
   189→      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    /* Hamburger */
   193→    .nav__hamburger {
   194→      display: none;
   195→      flex-direction: column;
   196→      justify-content: center;
   197→      gap: 5px;
   198→      width: 36px;
   199→      height: 36px;
   200→      background: none;
   201→      border: none;

   204→    }
   205→
   206→    .nav__hamburger span {

   212→    }
   213→
   214→    .nav__hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
   215→      transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
   216→    }
   217→
   218→    .nav__hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
   219→      opacity: 0;
   220→    }
   221→
   222→    .nav__hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
   223→      transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
   224→    }
   225→
   226→    /* ===== Hero Section ===== */
   227→    .hero {
   228→      position: relative;
   229→      min-height: 100vh;
   230→      display: flex;
   231→      align-items: center;
   232→      justify-content: center;
   233→      background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--bos-navy) 0%, #0e2240 40%, var(--bos-blue) 100%);
   234→      overflow: hidden;
   235→      padding: calc(var(--nav-height) + 40px) 24px 80px;
   236→    }
   237→
   238→    /* Geometric grid pattern overlay */
   239→    .hero__pattern {
   240→      position: absolute;
   241→      inset: 0;
   242→      opacity: 0.04;
   243→      background-image:
   244→        linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 1px, transparent 1px),
   245→        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 1px, transparent 1px);
   246→      background-size: 60px 60px;
   247→    }
   248→
   249→    /* Radio wave animation */
   250→    .hero__waves {
   251→      position: absolute;
   252→      top: 50%;
   253→      left: 50%;
   254→      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
   255→      pointer-events: none;
   256→    }
   257→
   258→    .hero__wave {
   259→      position: absolute;
   260→      top: 50%;
   261→      left: 50%;
   262→      width: 200px;
   263→      height: 200px;
   264→      margin-top: -100px;
   265→      margin-left: -100px;
   266→      border: 1px solid rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15);
   267→      border-radius: 50%;
   268→      animation: wave-expand 4s ease-out infinite;
   269→    }
   270→
   271→    .hero__wave:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 1s; }
   272→    .hero__wave:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 2s; }
   273→    .hero__wave:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 3s; }
   274→
   275→    @keyframes wave-expand {
   276→      0% {
   277→        width: 200px;
   278→        height: 200px;
   279→        margin-top: -100px;
   280→        margin-left: -100px;
   281→        opacity: 0.5;
   282→      }
   283→      100% {
   284→        width: 1200px;
   285→        height: 1200px;
   286→        margin-top: -600px;
   287→        margin-left: -600px;
   288→        opacity: 0;
   289→      }
   290→    }
   291→
   292→    .hero__content {

   296→      max-width: 820px;
   297→    }

   299→    .hero__badge {

   304→      background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.12);

   346→    /* ===== Buttons ===== */
   347→    .btn {
   348→      display: inline-flex;

   409→    /* ===== Section Shared Styles ===== */

   460→    /* ===== About / Feature Cards ===== */
   461→    .features {
   462→      display: grid;

   464→      gap: 28px;

   467→    .feature-card {

   477→    .feature-card::before {

   540→      text-align: center;

   660→    /* ===== Join / Mitglied werden ===== */

  1109→  <!-- ===== Über uns ===== -->
  1110→  <section class="section" id="ueber-uns">
  1111→    <div class="container">
  1112→      <div class="section__header reveal">
  1113→        <span class="section__label">Über uns</span>
  1114→        <h2 class="section__title">Wer wir sind</h2>
  1115→        <div class="section-divider"></div>
  1116→        <p class="section__intro">Der Verein bezweckt die Erhaltung, Förderung und Verbreitung des Amateurfunkwesens innerhalb des Wirkungsbereiches der Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben (BOS).</p>
  1117→      </div>
  1118→      <div class="features">
  1119→        <div class="feature-card reveal">
  1120→          <div class="feature-card__icon">
  1121→            <i data-lucide="shield-check" style="width:26px;height:26px;"></i>
  1122→          </div>
  1123→          <h3 class="feature-card__title">Sicherheit</h3>
  1124→          <p class="feature-card__text">Amateurfunk als verlässliche Kommunikation für BOS-Organisationen — auch dann, wenn andere Systeme ausfallen.</p>
  1125→        </div>
  1126→        <div class="feature-card reveal">
  1127→          <div class="feature-card__icon">
  1128→            <i data-lucide="radio-tower" style="width:26px;height:26px;"></i>
  1129→          </div>
  1130→          <h3 class="feature-card__title">Vernetzung</h3>
  1131→          <p class="feature-card__text">Verbindung von Funkamateuren aus Polizei, Feuerwehr und Rettung zu einer starken, übergreifenden Gemeinschaft.</p>
  1132→        </div>
  1133→        <div class="feature-card reveal">
  1134→          <div class="feature-card__icon">
  1135→            <i data-lucide="graduation-cap" style="width:26px;height:26px;"></i>
  1136→          </div>
  1137→          <h3 class="feature-card__title">Ausbildung</h3>
  1138→          <p class="feature-card__text">Förderung der Amateurfunk-Kompetenz im BOS-Bereich durch gezielte Aus- und Weiterbildung.</p>
  1139→        </div>
  1140→      </div>
  1141→    </div>
  1142→  </section>

  1374→      entries.forEach(entry => {

  1376→          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
  1377→          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);

- Feature card accent bars moved to bottom edge
- Overall more restrained, institutional aesthetic

```
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "=== Host Node Bootstrap Script ==="

# Check if running as root
if [ "$EUID" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Please run as normal user (not root)"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if Docker is installed
if command -v docker &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Docker already installed: $(docker --version)"
else
    echo "Installing Docker..."
    
    # Install prerequisites
    sudo apt-get update
    sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl
    
    # Add Docker GPG key
    sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
    sudo curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
    sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
    
    # Add Docker repo
    echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo ${VERSION_CODENAME}) stable" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null
    
    # Install Docker
    sudo apt-get update
    sudo apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
    
    # Add user to docker group
    sudo usermod -aG docker $USER
    
    echo "Docker installed. Please log out and back in for group changes to take effect."
fi

# Enable Docker to start on boot
sudo systemctl enable docker
sudo systemctl enable containerd

echo ""
echo "=== Bootstrap complete ==="
echo "Docker: $(docker --version)"
echo "Compose: $(docker compose version)"
```

         - hostname: *

{
  "file_path": "/home/achildrenmile/bosarsa/INSTALLATION.md",
  "content": "# BOS-ARSA Website — Installationsanleitung\n\nDiese Anleitung beschreibt, wie die BOS-ARSA Homepage auf einer bestehenden Hosting-Umgebung installiert wird. Es werden keine besonderen technischen Kenntnisse benötigt — die Installation erfolgt ausschließlich durch Kopieren von Dateien.\n\n## Voraussetzungen\n\n- Zugang zu einem Webhosting (z. B. über FTP, SFTP oder ein Dateimanager-Panel wie cPanel, Plesk, etc.)\n- Die Möglichkeit, Dateien auf den Webserver hochzuladen\n\n## Dateien im Überblick\n\n| Datei | Beschreibung |\n|---|---|\n| `index.html` | Die gesamte Website (HTML, CSS und JavaScript in einer Datei) |\n| `logo.webp` | Optimiertes Logo im WebP-Format (37 KB) |\n| `logo-web.png` | Logo als PNG-Fallback für ältere Browser (71 KB) |\n| `favicon/favicon.ico` | Favicon im ICO-Format |\n| `favicon/favicon.svg` | Favicon im SVG-Format |\n| `favicon/favicon-96x96.png` | Favicon als PNG (96x96 Pixel) |\n| `favicon/apple-touch-icon.png` | Icon für Apple-Geräte |\n| `favicon/site.webmanifest` | Web-App-Manifest für mobile Geräte |\n| `favicon/web-app-manifest-192x192.png` | App-Icon 192x192 |\n| `favicon/web-app-manifest-512x512.png` | App-Icon 512x512 |\n\n## Installation — Schritt für Schritt\n\n### 1. Dateien herunterladen\n\nAlle benötigten Dateien von GitHub herunterladen:\n\n1. Öffne https://github.com/achildrenmile/bosarsa\n2. Klicke auf den grünen Button **„Code\"** → **„Download ZIP\"**\n3. Entpacke die ZIP-Datei auf deinem Computer\n\n### 2. Dateien auf den Webserver hochladen\n\nVerbinde dich mit deinem Webhosting (per FTP-Programm wie FileZilla oder über den Dateimanager deines Hosters) und navigiere zum **Stammverzeichnis** (Root) deiner Website. Das ist üblicherweise:\n\n- `public_html/`\n- `htdocs/`\n- `www/`\n\nLade folgende Dateien und Ordner in das Stammverzeichnis hoch:\n\n```\npublic_html/\n├── index.html\n├── logo.webp\n├── logo-web.png\n├── favicon.ico          (aus dem favicon-Ordner)\n├── favicon.svg          (aus dem favicon-Ordner)\n├── favicon-96x96.png    (aus dem favicon-Ordner)\n├── apple-touch-icon.png (aus dem favicon-Ordner)\n├── site.webmanifest     (aus dem favicon-Ordner)\n├── web-app-manifest-192x192.png (aus dem favicon-Ordner)\n└── web-app-manifest-512x512.png (aus dem favicon-Ordner)\n```\n\n**Wichtig:** Die Favicon-Dateien müssen direkt im Stammverzeichnis liegen (nicht in einem Unterordner), da die `index.html` sie unter `/favicon.ico`, `/favicon.svg` usw. erwartet.\n\n### 3. Bestehende Website ersetzen\n\nFalls bereits eine Website vorhanden ist (z. B. eine WordPress-Installation):\n\n1. **Sicherung erstellen:** Lade die bestehende `index.html` (oder `index.php`) herunter und speichere sie als Backup auf deinem Computer\n2. **Alte Datei umbenennen oder löschen:** Benenne die alte Startseite um (z. B. in `index_alt.html`) oder lösche sie\n3. **Neue Datei hochladen:** Lade die neue `index.html` hoch\n\n> **Hinweis bei WordPress:** Falls WordPress installiert ist, muss die `index.php` im Stammverzeichnis ersetzt oder umbenannt werden, damit die neue `index.html` geladen wird. Alternativ kann WordPress auch komplett deinstalliert werden, falls es nicht mehr benötigt wird.\n\n### 4. Fertig\n\nDie Website sollte jetzt unter deiner Domain erreichbar sein. Öffne die URL im Browser und prüfe, ob alles korrekt angezeigt wird.\n\n## Anpassungen\n\n### E-Mail-Adresse ändern\n\nDie Kontakt-E-Mail `office@bos-arsa.at` ist an mehreren Stellen in der `index.html` hinterlegt. Um sie zu ändern, öffne die Datei in einem Texteditor und suche nach `office@bos-arsa.at` — ersetze alle Vorkommen durch die neue Adresse.\n\n### Logo austauschen\n\nUm das Logo zu ändern:\n\n1. Erstelle eine neue Bilddatei im **WebP-Format** (empfohlen, max. 800 px breit) und benenne sie `logo.webp`\n2. Erstelle zusätzlich eine **PNG-Version** als Fallback und benenne sie `logo-web.png`\n3. Lade beide Dateien in das Stammverzeichnis hoch und überschreibe die bestehenden\n\n### Vorstandsmitglieder ändern\n\nDie Vorstandsdaten befinden sich im Abschnitt `<!-- Vorstand -->` in der `index.html`. Suche nach dem entsprechenden Namen und ändere ihn direkt im HTML.\n\n## Fehlerbehebung\n\n| Problem | Lösung |\n|---|---|\n| Logo wird nicht angezeigt | Prüfe, ob `logo.webp` und `logo-web.png` im Stammverzeichnis liegen |\n| Favicon fehlt | Favicon-Dateien müssen direkt im Stammverzeichnis liegen, nicht in einem Unterordner |\n| Seite wird nicht angezeigt | Stelle sicher, dass die Datei exakt `index.html` heißt (Kleinbuchstaben) |\n| Alte Seite wird noch angezeigt | Browser-Cache leeren (Strg+Shift+R) oder im Inkognito-Modus öffnen |\n| Schriftarten laden nicht | Die Schriftarten werden von Google Fonts geladen — eine Internetverbindung ist erforderlich |\n\n## Kontakt\n\nBei Fragen zur Installation: **office@bos-arsa.at**\n"
}
```

The simplest way is via nginx config in the container. Let me add a redirect rule.

> TOOL

tool_use Write
id: toolu_01WXhpqtmn81LBcun4Jae7yu
```json
{
  "file_path": "/home/achildrenmile/bosarsa/nginx.conf",
  "content": "server {\n    listen 80;\n    server_name bosarsademo.oeradio.at;\n    return 301 https://bosarsa.oeradio.at$request_uri;\n}\n\nserver {\n    listen 80 default_server;\n    server_name bosarsa.oeradio.at;\n\n    root /usr/share/nginx/html;\n    index index.html;\n\n    location / {\n        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;\n    }\n}\n"
}
```

{
  "file_path": "/home/achildrenmile/bosarsa/nginx.conf",
  "content": "server {\n    listen 80;\n    server_name bosarsademo.oeradio.at;\n    return 301 https://bosarsa.oeradio.at$request_uri;\n}\n\nserver {\n    listen 80 default_server;\n    server_name bosarsa.oeradio.at;\n\n    root /usr/share/nginx/html;\n    index index.html;\n\n    # HTML — always revalidate, never serve stale\n    location ~* \\.html$ {\n        add_header Cache-Control \"no-cache, must-revalidate\";\n        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;\n    }\n\n    location = / {\n        add_header Cache-Control \"no-cache, must-revalidate\";\n        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;\n    }\n\n    # Video — cache longer (1 day)\n    location ~* \\.mp4$ {\n        add_header Cache-Control \"public, max-age=86400\";\n    }\n\n    # Images, fonts, icons — cache 1 week\n    location ~* \\.(png|webp|ico|svg|woff2?|ttf)$ {\n        add_header Cache-Control \"public, max-age=604800\";\n    }\n\n    location / {\n        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;\n    }\n}\n"
}

- **Video** (`.mp4`): 1 Tag Cache

> AGENT

Found it. `wget` resolves `localhost` to IPv6 `[::1]` but nginx is only listening on IPv4. The fix is to use `127.0.0.1` instead of `localhost`.

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_01SWQK4dPEp5gAubT7RQPAqW
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/home/achildrenmile/bosarsa/docker-compose.yml",
  "old_string": "      test: [\"CMD\", \"wget\", \"--no-verbose\", \"--tries=1\", \"--spider\", \"http://localhost:80/\"]",
  "new_string": "      test: [\"CMD\", \"wget\", \"--no-verbose\", \"--tries=1\", \"--spider\", \"http://127.0.0.1:80/\"]"
}
```

> AGENT

For hosting on bos-arsa.at without Docker, here's what's needed:

**1. Static files to deploy:**
- `index.html`, `impressum.html`, `datenschutz.html`
- `logo-web.png`, `logo.webp`
- `fonts/` (4 WOFF2 files)
- `favicon/` (icons + webmanifest)
- `bosarsavideo.mp4`, `kommunikationwennnichtsmehrgeht.mp4`

**2. Web server on the target host:**
- nginx or Apache must be installed
- Configure a vhost for `bos-arsa.at` pointing to the file directory
- Apply the same cache-control rules (HTML no-cache, assets cached)

**3. SSL/TLS:**
- Let's Encrypt via certbot for `bos-arsa.at` (and `www.bos-arsa.at` if needed)

**4. DNS:**
- A/AAAA record for `bos-arsa.at` pointing to the server IP
- Optionally CNAME for `www.bos-arsa.at`

**5. Code changes needed:**
- Update `impressum.html` and `datenschutz.html` if they reference `bosarsa.oeradio.at`
- Update the redirect in nginx (currently redirects `bosarsademo` → `bosarsa.oeradio.at`) to the new domain
- Update links in footer if any point to the old domain

**6. Optional:**
- Redirect `bosarsa.oeradio.at` → `bos-arsa.at` so the old URL still works

{
  "file_path": "/home/achildrenmile/bosarsa/llms.txt",
  "content": "# BOS-ARSA — Österreichischer Amateurfunkverein der Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben\n\n> BOS-Amateur-Radio-Society-Austria (BOS-ARSA) ist ein österreichischer Verein, der den Amateurfunk innerhalb der Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben (BOS) fördert. Der Verein stellt sicher, dass Kommunikation auch dann funktioniert, wenn herkömmliche Infrastruktur ausfällt.\n\n## Über den Verein\n\nBOS-ARSA wurde gegründet, um den Amateurfunk als zuverlässige Notfall- und Sicherheitskommunikation in Österreich zu etablieren. Der Verein richtet sich an Mitglieder von Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben (BOS), darunter Polizei, Feuerwehr, Rettungsdienste und Katastrophenschutz.\n\n## Zweck\n\nDer Verein bezweckt die Erhaltung, Förderung und Verbreitung des Amateurfunkwesens innerhalb des Wirkungsbereiches der Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben (BOS).\n\n## Ziele\n\n- Ausbildung & Lizenzierung: Unterstützung bei der Erlangung von Amateurfunklizenzen für BOS-Angehörige\n- Notfallkommunikation: Aufbau redundanter Kommunikationswege für Krisensituationen\n- Netzwerkaufbau: Vernetzung von Funkamateuren im BOS-Bereich in ganz Österreich\n- Übungen & Training: Regelmäßige Funkübungen und Weiterbildungen\n- Zusammenarbeit: Kooperation mit Behörden, Einsatzorganisationen und verwandten Vereinen\n\n## Vorstand\n\n- Obmann: Wolfgang Gabrutsch, OE8WGK\n- Obmann-Stellvertreter: Patrick Holzer, OE8HPK\n- Kassier: Martin Pernull, OE8MPK\n- Kassier-Stellvertreterin: Elena Brandstätter, OE8ELB\n- Schriftführer: Michael Linder, OE8YML\n- Schriftführer-Stellvertreter: Peter Enengl, OE8PEQ\n\n## Kontakt\n\n- E-Mail: office@bos-arsa.at\n- Sitz: c/o Wolfgang Gabrutsch, Buchengasse 3, 9020 Klagenfurt am Wörthersee, Österreich\n- ZVR-Zahl: 1783847541\n\n## Links\n\n- Website: https://bosarsa.oeradio.at\n- Domain: https://bosarsa.at (leitet weiter auf bosarsa.oeradio.at)\n- BOS-ARSA Log: https://bosarsalog.oeradio.at\n- Dachverband ÖVSV: https://oevsv.at\n"
}

> AGENT

Erledigt. Alles live. Hier eine Zusammenfassung was hinzugefügt wurde:

**SEO Meta-Tags (index.html):**
- `canonical` URL auf `bosarsa.oeradio.at`
- Erweiterte `description` mit relevanten Keywords
- `keywords`, `author`, `robots` Meta-Tags
- Open Graph Tags inkl. `og:image`, `og:site_name`
- Twitter Card Tags (`summary_large_image`)
- JSON-LD `Organization` Schema (Name, Adresse, E-Mail, Logo, Mitgliedschaft ÖVSV)

**Canonical + Robots (impressum.html, datenschutz.html):**
- `canonical` URLs
- `robots: index, follow`

**Neue Dateien:**
- **`robots.txt`** — erlaubt alle Crawler, verweist auf Sitemap
- **`sitemap.xml`** — alle 3 Seiten mit Prioritäten
- **`llms.txt`** — vollständige Vereinsbeschreibung für LLM-Crawler (Zweck, Ziele, Vorstand, Kontakt, Links)

**nginx:** Cache-Regeln für SEO-Dateien (1 Tag)

Here is a comprehensive compilation of all press articles, news, and media coverage about BOS-ARSA that I was able to find across the web.

---

## Complete Media Coverage of BOS-ARSA

### Background

BOS-ARSA (full name: "Osterreichischer Amateurfunkverein der Behorden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben -- BOS-Amateur-Radio-Society-Austria") was founded on December 16, 2019, by Dr. Wolfgang Gabrutsch (callsign OE8GWQ). It is registered as ADL 820 within the OEVSV (Austrian Amateur Radio Association) structure, based at the Landespolizeidirektion Karnten, Buchengasse 3, 9020 Klagenfurt am Worthersee. The organization has approximately 80 members and its purpose is creating communication interfaces between the OEVSV emergency radio system and the control centers of authorities and security organizations for crisis and disaster scenarios.

---

### 1. NEWS ARTICLES

**Article 1:**
- **Title:** "BOS-ARSA und NOTFUNK -- Fachgesprach in Karnten"
- **URL:** https://www.oevsv.REDACTED
- **Source:** OEVSV (Osterreichischer Versuchssenderverband) -- official Austrian amateur radio association website
- **Date:** July 13, 2021
- **Author:** Kevin Mekul (OE8KKM)
- **Description:** Reports on a specialist discussion about emergency radio operations and BOS-ARSA ADL820 held on July 10 at Pressegger See. Participants with callsigns OE3KYS, OE8IMK, OE8SCQ, OE8OWK, OE8FCK, OE8GWQ, and PE1AVP exchanged experiences and discussed future plans. The article also covers BOS-ARSA representatives welcoming participants at a DX camp in Dobriach on July 10, and a presentation at the Blaulicht-Stammtisch (emergency services coordination meeting) on July 12 in Bleiburg, where officials from the Volkermarkt district discussed establishing a radio station in the district administrator's crisis management center. The article notes plans for communication to emergency radio operators in "light islands" of communities during infrastructure failures.

---

**Article 2:**
- **Title:** "Kurzwelle & Co: Die Welt der Funkamateure"
- **URL:** https://www.meinbezirk.at/klagenfurt-land/c-leute/die-welt-der-funkamateure_a4596338
- **Source:** MeinBezirk.at (regional Austrian news portal -- Klagenfurt Land)
- **Date:** April 28, 2021
- **Author:** Bernhard Knaus (Freie Redaktion)
- **Description:** A regional newspaper article exploring the world of amateur radio, with Oberst Wolfgang Gabrutsch as a central figure. The article covers how Gabrutsch, a police officer from Feistritz im Rosental, founded BOS-ARSA in 2019. Key details include: BOS-ARSA has approximately 80 members; the organization was recently integrated into the OEVSV; Gabrutsch holds license OE8GWQ and advocates for emergency preparedness during blackout scenarios; the organization prepares relay stations with autonomous power supplies for crisis communication. The article also provides statistics: 6,760 licensed callsigns in Austria, 572 in Karnten, 89 in Klagenfurt City, 26 in Klagenfurt Land.

---

### 2. BLOG / REFERENCE ARTICLES

**Article 3:**
- **Title:** "Not- und Katastrophenfunk Kapitel 2 -- Verschiedene Notfunkkonzepte im Uberblick"
- **URL:** https://www.mh-is.at/?p=1158
- **Source:** OE3EGH und OE3XEG (amateur radio blog/website)
- **Date:** April 22, 2022
- **Author:** mhaiderer
- **Description:** A detailed overview of various emergency radio concepts in Austria. Contains a dedicated section on "BOS-ARSA bzw. ADL820" describing how the organization has developed its own emergency radio concept from Carinthia. It explains that BOS-ARSA trains members of rescue organizations, firefighters, lifeguards, and police as amateur radio operators to assist in emergencies. Notes that BOS-ARSA training is offered free of charge for non-members. References two podcast episodes by Mike OE1CMW about BOS-ARSA.

---

**Article 4:**
- **Title:** "Amateurfunkkurs" (Amateur Radio Course)
- **URL:** https://www.oewr-kaernten.at/cms/blog/amateurfunkkurs-4963/
- **Source:** Osterreichische Wasserrettung Karnten (Austrian Water Rescue Carinthia)
- **Date:** September/October 2021
- **Description:** Reports that BOS-ARSA organized and conducted a five-day amateur radio course at the Red Cross emergency rescue station in Ferlach. Eight emergency responders from the Austrian Water Rescue completed the training and passed the final examination on September 30, 2021 before the telecommunications authority commission (Fernmeldebuero) in Klagenfurt. All participants obtained the CEPT License. The article notes participants invested approximately 50 volunteer hours, and the newly certified operators will primarily support disaster protection operations and water rescue unit deployments.

---

### 3. PODCAST EPISODES

**Episode 5:**
- **Title:** "BOS-ARSA, Notfunkbrucke zu den Blaulichtorganisationen"
- **URL (Apple Podcasts):** https://podcasts.apple.com/at/podcast/bos-arsa-notfunkbr%C3%REDACTED?i=1000543228793
- **URL (Spotify):** https://podcasters.spotify.REDACTED
- **Source:** "ON AIR - Amateurfunk D-A-CH" podcast
- **Date:** November 27, 2021
- **Duration:** 20 minutes
- **Season/Episode:** Season 1, Episode 12
- **Host:** Michael Wurzinger (OE3CMW)
- **Guest:** Wolfgang Gabrutsch (OE8GWQ)
- **Description:** The episode features BOS-ARSA president Wolfgang Gabrutsch discussing the BOS-ARSA project as an "emergency radio bridge connecting to the radio services of emergency organizations" (Notfunkprojekt mit Anbindung an die Funkdienste der Blaulichtorganisationen). Covers the organization's mission, structure, and role in crisis communication.

---

**Episode 6:**
- **Title:** "BOS-ARSA, Ausbildung"
- **URL (Apple Podcasts):** https://podcasts.apple.com/at/podcast/bos-arsa-ausbildung/id1567406204?i=1000544591807
- **URL (Spotify):** https://creators.spotify.REDACTED
- **Source:** "ON AIR - Amateurfunk D-A-CH" podcast
- **Date:** December 10, 2021
- **Duration:** 21 minutes
- **Season/Episode:** Season 2, Episode 1
- **Host:** Michael Wurzinger (OE3CMW)
- **Guest:** Lukas Spitzer (OE8LSR)
- **Description:** Lukas Spitzer discusses training and further education within the BOS-ARSA group, including how the organization prepares members of security and emergency organizations for amateur radio certification exams, and the interfaces created between OEVSV emergency radio and security organization dispatch centers.

---

Rene Camaur; Assistant Treasurer Thomas Joham; Secretary Jurgen Kugi; Assistant Secretary Erwin Weger. Registered address: Buchengasse 3, 9020 Klagenfurt am Worthersee. ZVR (registry number): 1783847541. Supervising authority: Landespolizeidirektion Karnten. Contact: office@bos-arsa.at.

November 2021 <span class=\"article__tag article__tag--podcast\">Podcast</span></div>\n      <h2 class=\"article__title\"><a href=\"https://podcasts.apple.com/at/podcast/bos-arsa-notfunkbr%C3%REDACTED?i=1000543228793\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">BOS-ARSA, Notfunkbrücke zu den Blaulichtorganisationen</a></h2>\n      <div class=\"article__source\">ON AIR — Amateurfunk D-A-CH Podcast, Staffel 1, Folge 12 — Host: Michael Wurzinger (OE3CMW), Gast: Wolfgang Gabrutsch (OE8GWQ)</div>\n      <p class=\"article__desc\">BOS-ARSA Obmann Wolfgang Gabrutsch stellt das Notfunkprojekt vor — eine Brücke zwischen dem Amateurfunk und den Funkdiensten der Blaulichtorganisationen für den Krisenfall.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <div class=\"article\">\n      <div class=\"article__date\">September 2021 <span class=\"article__tag article__tag--kurs\">Ausbildung</span></div>\n      <h2 class=\"article__title\"><a href=\"https://www.oewr-kaernten.at/cms/blog/amateurfunkkurs-4963/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">Amateurfunkkurs — 8 Einsatzkräfte erfolgreich lizenziert</a></h2>\n      <div class=\"article__source\">Österreichische Wasserrettung Kärnten</div>\n      <p class=\"article__desc\">BOS-ARSA organisierte einen fünftägigen Amateurfunkkurs bei der Rot-Kreuz-Rettungsstelle in Ferlach.    179→      border-radius: var(--radius);
   180→    }
   181→    .nav__brand-text {
   182→      display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.15;
   183→    }
   184→    .nav__brand-name {
   185→      font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: .5px;
   186→      color: var(--bos-gold);
   187→    }
   188→    .nav__brand-sub {
   189→      font-size: .65rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .3px;
   190→      color: var(--gray-300); white-space: nowrap;
   191→    }
   192→
   193→    .nav__links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; list-style: none; }
   194→    .nav__links a {
   195→      display: block; padding: 8px 16px;
   196→      color: var(--gray-300); font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500;
   197→      letter-spacing: .2px; border-radius: var(--radius);
   198→      transition: color .2s, background .2s; text-decoration: none;
   199→    }
   200→    .nav__links a:hover { color: var(--white); background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
   201→
   202→    .nav__hamburger {
   203→      display: none; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
   204→      gap: 5px; width: 40px; height: 40px;
   205→      background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 6px;
   206→    }
   207→    .nav__hamburger span {
   208→      display: block; width: 100%; height: 2px;
   209→      background: var(--gray-300); transition: transform .3s, opacity .3s;
   210→      border-radius: 1px;
   211→    }
   212→    .nav__hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
   213→    .nav__hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
   214→    .nav__hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }
   215→
   216→    /* ===== Hero ===== */
   217→    .hero {
   218→      position: relative;
   219→      min-height: 100vh;
   220→      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   221→      background: var(--polizei-dark);
   222→      overflow: hidden;
   223→      padding: calc(var(--nav-h) + 48px) 24px 80px;
   224→    }
   225→
   226→    /* Gradient overlay for depth */
   227→    .hero::before {
   228→      content: '';
   229→      position: absolute; inset: 0;
   230→      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 50%, rgba(43,67,112,.4) 0%, transparent 60%),
   231→                  radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 80%, rgba(27,42,74,.6) 0%, transparent 50%);
   232→      z-index: 1;
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    /* Subtle grid lines */
   236→    .hero__grid {
   237→      position: absolute; inset: 0;
   238→      background-image:
   239→        linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
   240→        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
   241→      background-size: 80px 80px;
   242→      z-index: 1;
   243→    }
   244→
   245→    /* Radio waves — concentric circles pulsing outward */
   246→    .hero__waves {
   247→      position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
   248→      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
   249→      z-index: 1; pointer-events: none;
   250→    }
   251→    .hero__wave {
   252→      position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
   253→      width: 160px; height: 160px;
   254→      margin: -80px 0 0 -80px;
   255→      border: 1.5px solid rgba(212,168,67,.1);
   256→      border-radius: 50%;
   257→      animation: pulse 5s ease-out infinite;
   258→    }
   259→    .hero__wave:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 1.25s; }
   260→    .hero__wave:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 2.5s; }
   261→    .hero__wave:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 3.75s; }
   262→    @keyframes pulse {
   263→      0% { width: 160px; height: 160px; margin: -80px 0 0 -80px; opacity: .45; }
   264→      100% { width: 1400px; height: 1400px; margin: -700px 0 0 -700px; opacity: 0; }
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    .hero__content {
   268→      position: relative; z-index: 2;
   269→      text-align: center; max-width: 780px;
   270→    }
   271→
   272→    .hero__logo {
   273→      width: 420px; max-width: 80vw;
   274→      height: auto;
   275→      margin: 0 auto 36px;
   276→      border-radius: 4px;
   277→      box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
   278→    }
   279→
   280→    .hero__title {
   281→      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.5vw, 3rem);
   282→      font-weight: 800; color: var(--white);
   283→      line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.3px;
   284→      margin-bottom: 16px;
   285→    }
   286→    .hero__title span { color: var(--bos-gold); }
   287→
   288→    .hero__subtitle {
   289→      font-size: clamp(.95rem, 1.8vw, 1.15rem);
   290→      color: var(--gray-300); font-weight: 400;
   291→      line-height: 1.65; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto 40px;
   292→    }
   293→
   294→    .hero__actions { display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
   295→
   296→    /* ===== Buttons ===== */
   297→    .btn {
   298→      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
   299→      padding: 13px 28px; font-family: var(--font-main);
   300→      font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .3px;
   301→      border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius);
   302→      cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s; text-decoration: none;
   303→    }
   304→    .btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--polizei-light); outline-offset: 2px; }
   305→
   306→    .btn--gold {
   307→      background: var(--bos-gold); color: var(--polizei-dark);
   308→      border-color: var(--bos-gold);
   309→    }
   310→    .btn--gold:hover {
   311→      background: var(--bos-gold-light); border-color: var(--bos-gold-light);
   312→      color: var(--polizei-dark); transform: translateY(-1px);
   313→      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(212,168,67,.25);
   314→    }
   315→
   316→    .btn--outline-white {
   317→      background: transparent; color: var(--white);
   318→      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.25);
   319→    }
   320→    .btn--outline-white:hover {
   321→      border-color: var(--white); color: var(--white);
   322→      background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); transform: translateY(-1px);
   323→    }
   324→
   325→    .btn--polizei {
   326→      background: var(--polizei-mid); color: var(--white);
   327→      border-color: var(--polizei-mid);
   328→    }
   329→    .btn--polizei:hover {
   330→      background: var(--polizei-light); border-color: var(--polizei-light);
   331→      color: var(--white); transform: translateY(-1px);
   332→      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(74,122,181,.25);
   333→    }
   334→
   335→    /* ===== Austrian flag stripe accent ===== */
   336→    .at-stripe {
   337→      height: 4px; width: 100%;
   338→      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--at-red) 33.33%, var(--white) 33.33%, var(--white) 66.66%, var(--at-red) 66.66%);
   339→    }
   340→
   341→    /* ===== Sections ===== */
   342→    .section { padding: 96px 0; }
   343→    .section--alt { background: var(--white); }
   344→    .section--dark {
   345→      background: linear-gradient(170deg, var(--polizei-navy) 0%, var(--polizei-dark) 100%);
   346→      color: var(--white);
   347→    }
   348→
   349→    .section__header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 56px; }
   350→    .section__label {
   351→      display: inline-block;
   352→      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: .72rem;
   353→      letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
   354→      color: var(--bos-gold); margin-bottom: 10px;
   355→    }
   356→    .section__title {
   357→      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.5vw, 2.2rem);
   358→      font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--gray-900);
   359→    }
   360→    .section--dark .section__title { color: var(--white); }
   361→    .section__rule {
   362→      width: 48px; height: 3px; background: var(--bos-gold);
   363→      margin: 14px auto 0; border-radius: 1px;
   364→    }
   365→    .section__intro {
   366→      max-width: 640px; margin: 20px auto 0;
   367→      color: var(--gray-500); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; text-align: center;
   368→    }
   369→    .section--dark .section__intro { color: var(--gray-300); }
   370→
   371→    /* ===== Video ===== */
   372→    .video-wrapper {
   373→      max-width: 860px;
   374→      margin: 0 auto;
   375→      border-radius: var(--radius);
   376→      overflow: hidden;
   377→      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(15,26,46,.12);
   378→      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
   379→      background: var(--polizei-dark);
   380→    }
   381→    .video-player {
   382→      width: 100%;
   383→      display: block;
   384→    }
   385→
   386→    /* ===== Feature Cards (Über uns) ===== */
   387→    .features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 24px; }
   388→    .feature-card {
   389→      background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
   390→      border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 36px 28px;
   391→      transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
   392→      position: relative;
   393→    }
   394→    .feature-card::after {
   395→      content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
   396→      height: 3px; background: var(--polizei-mid);
   397→      transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .35s;
   398→    }
   399→    .feature-card:hover {
   400→      transform: translateY(-3px);
   401→      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(15,26,46,.08);
   402→    }
   403→    .feature-card:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
   404→
   405→    .feature-card__icon {
   406→      width: 48px; height: 48px;
   407→      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   408→      background: var(--polizei-navy); color: var(--bos-gold);
   409→      border-radius: var(--radius); margin-bottom: 18px;
   410→    }
   411→    .feature-card__title {
   412→      font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700;
   413→      color: var(--gray-900); margin-bottom: 8px;
   414→    }
   415→    .feature-card__text {
   416→      color: var(--gray-500); font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.6;
   417→    }
   418→
   419→    /* ===== Board Grid ===== */
   420→    .board-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 20px; }
   421→    .board-card {
   422→      background: var(--off-white); border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
   423→      border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 32px 24px; text-align: center;
   424→      transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
   425→    }
   426→    .board-card:hover {
   427→      transform: translateY(-2px);
   428→      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(15,26,46,.06);
   429→    }
   430→    .board-card--president {
   431→      background: var(--polizei-dark);
   432→      border-color: rgba(212,168,67,.2);
   433→    }
   434→    .board-card--president .board-card__name { color: var(--white); }
   435→    .board-card--president .board-card__credentials { color: var(--gray-300); }
   436→
   437→    .board-card__avatar {
   438→      width: 56px; height: 56px; margin: 0 auto 16px;
   439→      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   440→      background: var(--polizei-navy); color: var(--gray-300);
   441→      border-radius: 50%;
   442→    }
   443→    .board-card--president .board-card__avatar {
   444→      background: var(--bos-gold); color: var(--polizei-dark);
   445→    }
   446→
   447→    .board-card__role {
   448→      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: .68rem;
   449→      letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
   450→      color: var(--bos-gold); margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 500;
   451→    }
   452→    .board-card__name {
   453→      font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gray-900); line-height: 1.25;
   454→    }
   455→    .board-card__credentials {
   456→      font-size: .78rem; color: var(--gray-300); margin-top: 4px;
   457→    }
   458→
   459→    /* ===== Goals ===== */
   460→    .goals-content {
   461→      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
   462→      gap: 56px; align-items: start;
   463→    }
   464→    .goals__statement {
   465→      font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 1.65rem);
   466→      font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); line-height: 1.45;
   467→    }
   468→    .goals__statement span { color: var(--bos-gold); }
   469→
   470→    .goals-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
   471→    .goals-list__item {
   472→      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px;
   473→      padding: 16px 18px;
   474→      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
   475→      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
   476→      border-radius: var(--radius);
   477→      transition: background .2s;
   478→    }
   479→    .goals-list__item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); }
   480→    .goals-list__icon {
   481→      flex-shrink: 0; width: 36px; height: 36px;
   482→      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   483→      background: rgba(212,168,67,.1); border-radius: var(--radius);
   484→      color: var(--bos-gold);
   485→    }
   486→    .goals-list__text {
   487→      color: var(--gray-300); font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.5; padding-top: 6px;
   488→    }
   489→
   490→    /* ===== Join Section ===== */
   491→    .join { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
   492→    .join__title {
   493→      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
   494→      font-weight: 800; color: var(--gray-900);
   495→      margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center;
   496→    }
   497→    .join__subtitle {
   498→      color: var(--gray-500); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 40px; text-align: center;
   499→      max-width: 680px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
   500→    }
   501→    .join__orgs {
   502→      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
   503→      gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 48px;
   504→    }
   505→    .join__org {
   506→      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
   507→      padding: 20px 12px; background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius);
   508→      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100); text-decoration: none;
   509→      transition: all .25s ease;
   510→    }
   511→    .join__org:hover {
   512→      border-color: var(--polizei-mid); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(59,90,140,.12);
   513→      transform: translateY(-2px);
   514→    }
   515→    .join__org-icon {
   516→      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
   517→      background: rgba(27,42,74,.08);
   518→      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   519→      flex-shrink: 0;
   520→    }
   521→    .join__org-icon i { width: 22px; height: 22px; color: var(--polizei-mid); }
   522→    .join__org:hover .join__org-icon { background: var(--polizei-mid); }
   523→    .join__org:hover .join__org-icon i { color: var(--white); }
   524→    .join__org-name {
   525→      font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-700);
   526→      text-align: center; line-height: 1.3;
   527→    }
   528→
   529→    .join__divider {
   530→      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 40px;
   531→    }
   532→    .join__divider::before, .join__divider::after {
   533→      content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--gray-100);
   534→    }
   535→    .join__divider-text {
   536→      font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-300);
   537→      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.5px; white-space: nowrap;
   538→    }
   539→
   540→    .join__foerder {
   541→      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--polizei-dark), var(--polizei-navy));
   542→      border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 36px 32px;
   543→      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px;
   544→      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
   545→    }
   546→    .join__foerder::before {
   547→      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: .03;
   548→      background-image:
   549→        linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.1) 1px, transparent 1px),
   550→        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.1) 1px, transparent 1px);
   551→      background-size: 40px 40px;
   552→    }
   553→    .join__foerder-icon {
   554→      width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%;
   555→      background: rgba(212,168,67,.15); display: flex;
   556→      align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
   557→      position: relative; z-index: 1;
   558→    }
   559→    .join__foerder-icon i { width: 26px; height: 26px; color: var(--bos-gold); }
   560→    .join__foerder-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; flex: 1; }
   561→    .join__foerder-title {
   562→      font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 6px;
   563→    }
   564→    .join__foerder-text {
   565→      font-size: .88rem; color: var(--gray-300); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 16px;
   566→    }
   567→    .join__foerder .btn { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
   568→
   569→    .join__cta {
   570→      text-align: center; margin-top: 40px;
   571→    }
   572→
   573→    /* ===== Partners ===== */
   574→    .partners { background: var(--white); border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100); }
   575→    .partners__label {
   576→      text-align: center; font-size: .85rem;
   577→      color: var(--gray-300); margin-bottom: 28px; letter-spacing: .3px;
   578→    }
   579→    .partners-grid { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 40px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
   580→    .partner-item {
   581→      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
   582→      padding: 20px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
   583→      border-radius: var(--radius); text-decoration: none; color: var(--gray-700);
   584→      transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
   585→    }
   586→    .partner-item:hover {
   587→      border-color: var(--polizei-mid);
   588→      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15,26,46,.05);
   589→      color: var(--polizei-navy);
   590→    }
   591→    .partner-item__logo { height: 36px; width: auto; }
   592→    .partner-item__info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
   593→    .partner-item__name { font-weight: 700; font-size: .95rem; }
   594→    .partner-item__desc { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--gray-300); }
   595→
   596→    /* ===== Footer ===== */
   597→    .footer {
   598→      background: var(--polizei-dark); color: var(--gray-300); padding: 56px 0 0;
   599→    }
   600→    .footer__inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; }
   601→    .footer__brand {
   602→      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 18px;
   603→    }
   604→    .footer__brand-logo { height: 40px; width: auto; border-radius: 2px; }
   605→    .footer__brand-name {
   606→      font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--bos-gold); letter-spacing: .5px;
   607→    }
   608→    .footer__org-name {
   609→      font-size: .84rem; line-height: 1.6;
   610→      color: rgba(168,180,194,.6); margin-bottom: 16px;
   611→    }
   612→    .footer__details {
   613→      font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.75; color: rgba(168,180,194,.5);
   614→    }
   615→    .footer__details a { color: var(--bos-gold); }
   616→    .footer__details a:hover { color: var(--bos-gold-light); }
   617→
   618→    .footer__links-title {
   619→      font-weight: 700; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--white);
   620→      letter-spacing: .5px; margin-bottom: 16px; text-transform: uppercase;
   621→    }
   622→    .footer__link-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
   623→    .footer__link-list a {
   624→      color: rgba(168,180,194,.5); font-size: .85rem; transition: color .2s;
   625→    }
   626→    .footer__link-list a:hover { color: var(--white); }
   627→
   628→    .footer__bottom {
   629→      margin-top: 40px; padding: 18px 0;
   630→      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
   631→      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
   632→      font-size: .78rem; color: rgba(168,180,194,.35);
   633→    }
   634→
   635→    /* ===== Responsive ===== */
   636→    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
   637→      .features { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); }
   638→      .board-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); }
   639→      .goals-content { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 36px; }
   640→      .goals__statement { text-align: center; }
   641→      .join__orgs { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
   642→      .join__foerder { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
   643→      .footer__inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
   644→    }
   645→
   646→    @media (max-width: 768px) {
   647→      :root { --nav-h: 60px; }
   648→      .nav__links {
   649→        position: fixed; top: var(--nav-h); left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
   650→        background: var(--polizei-dark);
   651→        flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch;
   652→        padding: 16px 24px; gap: 2px;

  1022→  <script>
  1023→    lucide.createIcons();
  1024→    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
  1025→
  1026→    // Nav scroll shadow
  1027→    const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  1028→    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  1029→      nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 20);
  1030→    }, { passive: true });
  1031→
  1032→    // Mobile menu
  1033→    const navToggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
  1034→    const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
  1035→    navToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
  1036→      const isOpen = navLinks.classList.toggle('open');
  1037→      navToggle.classList.toggle('active');
  1038→      navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
  1039→      navToggle.setAttribute('aria-label', isOpen ? 'Menü schließen' : 'Menü öffnen');
  1040→      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  1041→    });
  1042→    navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
  1043→      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
  1044→        navLinks.classList.remove('open');
  1045→        navToggle.classList.remove('active');
  1046→        navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  1047→        document.body.style.overflow = '';
  1048→      });
  1049→    });
  1050→
  1051→    // Scroll reveal
  1052→    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  1053→      entries.forEach(e => {
  1054→        if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('visible'); observer.unobserve(e.target); }
  1055→      });
  1056→    }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });
  1057→    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  1058→
  1059→    // Stagger children
  1060→    document.querySelectorAll('.features, .board-grid').forEach(grid => {
  1061→      grid.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach((c, i) => { c.style.transitionDelay = `${i * .08}s`; });
  1062→    });
  1063→  </script>

### 3. DOCKERFILE & DOCKER-COMPOSE.YML

**Dockerfile** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsa/Dockerfile`):
```dockerfile

COPY impressum.html /usr/share/nginx/html/impressum.html

EXPOSE 80
```

**docker-compose.yml** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsa/docker-compose.yml`):
```yaml
services:
  bosarsa:
    build: .
    container_name: bosarsa
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3417:80"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://127.0.0.1:80/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 5s
    networks:
      - cloudflared-tunnel

networks:
  cloudflared-tunnel:
    external: true
```

**Key characteristics:**
- Running nginx:alpine as the container
- Single port exposed: 3417 (mapped to 80)
- Cloudflare tunnel integration
- Health checks enabled (HTTP wget test)
- Restart unless-stopped policy

### 4. DEPLOY SCRIPT

**deploy-production.sh** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsa/deploy-production.sh` - 78 lines):

A bash script that:
1. Loads `.env.production` environment variables
2. Validates required variables (DEPLOY_HOST, REMOTE_DIR, CONTAINER_NAME, IMAGE_NAME, CONTAINER_PORT, SITE_URL)
3. Supports `--rebuild` flag for cache-free builds
4. Uses rsync to sync files to remote server (excludes .git and .env.production)
5. SSHs into remote host to:
   - Build Docker image
   - Runs `docker compose up -d --force-recreate --build`
6. Verifies deployment by:
   - Checking container status
   - Testing local port accessibility
   - Testing public URL accessibility
7. Outputs color-coded messages (GREEN, RED, YELLOW)

### KEY INSIGHTS FOR TEMPLATING/SSG INTRODUCTION

**Pain Points a Static Site Generator Would Address:**

1. **High code duplication:** Navigation and footer appear in 4 separate HTML files
2. **Metadata repetition:** Font-face declarations, CSS variables, and basic styling repeated across pages
3. **No build process:** Manual updates needed to metadata, styles, or shared components
4. **Scaling issues:** Adding a 5th page requires copying 100+ lines of boilerplate
5. **JavaScript duplication:** Hamburger menu and scroll effects replicated

**Benefits of a templating system:**
- **DRY principle:** Single source for nav/footer/head
- **Easier maintenance:** Update header once, it changes everywhere
- **Consistency:** Guaranteed same styles/scripts across pages
- **Scalability:** Add pages instantly without boilerplate
- **Change management:** Update company address in one place
- **Variables:** Easy font, color, or text changes

**Recommended approaches:**
1. **11ty (Eleventy):** Zero-config, handles HTML, minimal JavaScript requirement
2. **Jekyll:** Simple, GitHub Pages ready, perfect for static sites
3. **Nunjucks/EJS templates:** Server-side templating with Node
4. **HTML templating library:** Keep Docker/nginx, just pre-process HTML at build time

The project is currently **100% static with pure HTML/CSS/JS**, making it an ideal candidate for a lightweight templating system that wouldn't disrupt the existing Docker/nginx deployment.

{
  "file_path": "/home/achildrenmile/.claude/plans/cryptic-bubbling-lake.md",
  "content": "# Plan: Migrate BOS-ARSA to Eleventy (11ty)\n\n## Context\n\nThe BOS-ARSA website has 4 HTML pages with massive code duplication — nav, footer, CSS variables, font-face declarations, favicons, and JS are copy-pasted across every file. Adding a new page means copying 150+ lines of boilerplate. The press page has 6 hand-coded article cards that will grow over time. SEO files (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt) are also manually maintained.\n\n**Goal:** Migrate to Eleventy (11ty) — a zero-config static site generator that outputs plain HTML. The nginx/Docker deployment stays identical, we just add a build step.\n\n## Why Eleventy\n\n- Zero-config, minimal dependencies (~1 npm package)\n- Nunjucks templating: layouts, partials, loops, data files\n- Output is plain static HTML — served by nginx exactly as before\n- JSON data files for press articles (add article = add JSON entry)\n- Can generate sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt from templates\n- No client-side framework — same HTML output as today\n\n## New Project Structure\n\n```\nbosarsa/\n├── src/\n│   ├── _includes/\n│   │   ├── base.njk              # Full HTML document shell\n│   │   ├── nav.njk               # Full navigation (logo, links, hamburger)\n│   │   └── footer.njk            # Full 3-column footer\n│   ├── _data/\n│   │   ├── site.json             # Global: name, url, email, address, ZVR, etc.\n│   │   └── presse.json           # Press articles array\n│   ├── css/\n│   │   └── base.css              # All shared CSS (vars, fonts, nav, footer, responsive)\n│   ├── index.njk                 # Homepage\n│   ├── presse.njk                # Press page (loops over presse.json)\n│   ├── impressum.njk             # Impressum (content only, layout from base)\n│   ├── datenschutz.njk           # Datenschutz (content only, layout from base)\n│   ├── robots.njk                # -> robots.txt\n│   ├── sitemap.njk               # -> sitemap.xml (auto-lists all pages)\n│   └── llms.njk                  # -> llms.txt (pulls from site.json)\n├── fonts/                         # Stays in root (passthrough copy)\n├── favicon/                       # Stays in root (passthrough copy)\n├── *.mp4, *.png, *.webp          # Static assets (passthrough copy)\n├── .eleventy.js                   # Eleventy config\n├── package.json                   # Just @11ty/eleventy\n├── Dockerfile                     # Multi-stage: node build -> nginx serve\n├── docker-compose.yml             # Unchanged\n├── deploy-production.sh           # Unchanged\n└── nginx.conf                     # Unchanged\n```\n\n## Key Files\n\n### 1. `src/_data/site.json` — Single source of truth\n```json\n{\n  \"name\": \"BOS-ARSA\",\n  \"fullName\": \"Österreichischer Amateurfunkverein der Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben\",\n  \"legalName\": \"BOS-Amateur-Radio-Society-Austria (BOS-ARSA)\",\n  \"url\": \"https://bosarsa.oeradio.at\",\n  \"email\": \"office@bos-arsa.at\",\n  \"address\": { ... },\n  \"zvr\": \"1783847541\",\n  \"vereinsbehoerde\": \"Landespolizeidirektion Kärnten\"\n}\n```\n\n### 2. `src/_data/presse.json` — Data-driven press articles\n```json\n[\n  {\n    \"date\": \"22. April 2022\",\n    \"tag\": \"blog\",\n    \"tagLabel\": \"Blog\",\n    \"title\": \"Not- und Katastrophenfunk — ...\",\n    \"url\": \"https://www.mh-is.at/?p=1158\",\n    \"source\": \"mh-is.at — OE3EGH und OE3XEG\",\n    \"desc\": \"Ausführlicher Überblick...\"\n  }\n]\n```\n\n### 3. `src/_includes/base.njk` — Single layout for all pages\n- `<head>` with fonts, CSS, favicons, SEO meta (title, description, canonical, OG, Twitter)\n- Includes `nav.njk` and `footer.njk`\n- Content block for page-specific content\n- Shared JS at bottom (lucide, year, hamburger, scroll)\n- Front matter controls: `title`, `description`, `canonical`, `activeNav`, `pageCSS`\n\n### 4. `src/presse.njk` — Loop replaces 6 copy-pasted cards\n```nunjucks\n{% for article in presse %}\n  <a class=\"article\" href=\"{{ article.url }}\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">\n    <div class=\"article__date\">{{ article.date }}\n      <span class=\"article__tag article__tag--{{ article.tag }}\">{{ article.tagLabel }}</span>\n    </div>\n    <h2 class=\"article__title\">{{ article.title }}</h2>\n    <div class=\"article__source\">{{ article.source }}</div>\n    <p class=\"article__desc\">{{ article.desc }}</p>\n  </a>\n{% endfor %}\n```\n\n### 5. SEO files — Generated from data\n- **sitemap.njk**: Loops over 11ty's `collections.all` to auto-list all pages\n- **robots.njk**: Simple template referencing `site.url`\n- **llms.njk**: Pulls org info from `site.json`, board members, etc.\n\n### 6. `Dockerfile` — Multi-stage build\n```dockerfile\nFROM node:20-alpine AS build\nWORKDIR /app\nCOPY package*.json ./\nRUN npm ci --production\nCOPY . .\nRUN npx @11ty/eleventy\n\nFROM nginx:alpine\nRUN rm /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf\nCOPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/bosarsa.conf\nCOPY --from=build /app/_site/ /usr/share/nginx/html/\nEXPOSE 80\n```\n\n### 7. `.eleventy.js` — Config\n- Input: `src/`, Output: `_site/`\n- Passthrough copy: `fonts/`, `favicon/`, `*.mp4`, `*.png`, `*.webp`, `nginx.conf`\n- Nunjucks as template engine\n\n## Also update impressum & datenschutz\n\nBoth currently have the old simple nav/footer. They'll get the full nav and full footer from the shared includes — consistent with presse.html and index.html.\n\n## What stays the same\n\n- `nginx.conf` — identical\n- `docker-compose.yml` — identical\n- `deploy-production.sh` — identical\n- All static assets (fonts, favicons, videos, images)\n- The final HTML output looks exactly the same to visitors\n\n## Implementation Steps\n\n1. `npm init` + install `@11ty/eleventy`\n2. Create `.eleventy.js` config\n3. Create `src/_data/site.json` and `src/_data/presse.json`\n4. Create `src/css/base.css` with all shared styles\n5. Create `src/_includes/base.njk`, `nav.njk`, `footer.njk`\n6. Convert `index.html` -> `src/index.njk`\n7. Convert `presse.html` -> `src/presse.njk` (data-driven loop)\n8. Convert `impressum.html` -> `src/impressum.njk`\n9. Convert `datenschutz.html` -> `src/datenschutz.njk`\n10. Create `src/robots.njk`, `src/sitemap.njk`, `src/llms.njk`\n11. Update `Dockerfile` to multi-stage build\n12. Update `.gitignore` (add `_site/`, `node_modules/`)\n13. Delete old root HTML files\n14. Test build locally, verify output matches current site\n15. Deploy\n\n## Verification\n\n1. Run `npx @11ty/eleventy` — should produce `_site/` with all files\n2. Compare `_site/index.html` output with current `index.html`\n3. Verify `_site/presse.html` renders all 6 articles\n4. Verify `_site/sitemap.xml`, `_site/robots.txt`, `_site/llms.txt` content\n5. Deploy and verify live site at https://bosarsa.oeradio.at\n"
}

The plan uses **Eleventy (11ty)** — a lightweight static site generator. Here's the summary:

- **Shared layouts**: Nav, footer, `<head>`, CSS, and JS defined once, used by all 4 pages
- **Data-driven press page**: Articles in `presse.json` — adding an article = adding a JSON entry, no HTML needed
- **Auto-generated SEO**: `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, `llms.txt` all generated from templates and site data
- **Same output**: Final result is plain HTML served by nginx — visitors see no difference
- **Multi-stage Docker**: Node builds the site, nginx serves it — deploy script stays the same
- **Bonus**: Impressum & Datenschutz also get the full nav/footer for consistency
